concept.name: Transformer model
concept.definition: A sequence model built from attention and position-wise transformations rather than recurrent state updates.
concept.intuition: It is a learnable mapping or representation used to turn features into predictions or groups.
concept.mechanics: Embed inputs with position information, apply multi-head self-attention and feed-forward blocks with residual connections and normalization, then map outputs to the task.
concept.failure_modes: Flexible models can fit noise, shift under new regimes, and conceal instability when tuning is repeated on the same validation data.
concept.misconceptions: Greater model complexity or in-sample accuracy does not by itself imply better out-of-sample trading results.
concept.example: A Transformer attends across 128 return observations in parallel and pools the encoded sequence for classification.

citations.source: Vaswani et al., Attention Is All You Need
citations.section: Sections 1 and 3: attention and Transformer architecture
